title: fw-hdl elaborated netlist, layer 1
description: The normalized form of an elaborated design: the conformance artifact (netlist.md). Every implementation's conformance runner produces it; the suite compares it with a scenario's expect.json. Two implementations given the same design must produce netlists that are equal as JSON values, and byte-identical in canonical text (keys sorted, two-space indent, one trailing newline: Python json.dumps(x, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n'). Array order is normative, and given under each array. All strings are ASCII. Paths are full names (elaboration.md): the top is named 'top'. Sorting is by Unicode code point (byte-wise for ASCII), so 'u[10]' sorts before 'u[2]'.

top.description: The created type of the top component.

objects.description: Every structural object in the tree, sorted by path. Objects not in the tree after an error (a duplicate name, late creation) are absent.

nets.description: Every net, listed in the scope that formed it (connections.md). A connection that crosses a hierarchy level gives one net in each scope. Sorted by scope, then by the least path among the net's endpoints (sources, sinks, signals, inouts).

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic reported, errors and warnings, each (id, path) pair once, sorted by path then id. A design elaborates successfully exactly when no id begins 'FW-E-'.

path.description: A full name: 'top', then '.' and a name for each level. A name is an SV identifier with zero or more '[<decimal>]' suffixes.

relpath.description: A path relative to an extern component: 'clk', 'in.valid'.

type.description:
Canonical type spelling, with no spaces except before 'signed':
- bit/logic vectors: the keyword, then ' signed' if signed, then each packed dimension as '[msb:lsb]' in decimal, as declared: 'bit', 'bit[7:0]', 'logic signed[3:0]'. Other built-in integral types by keyword: 'int', 'byte', 'longint'.
- A typedef of a vector type resolves to the vector: 'u8_t' is spelled 'bit[7:0]'. A typedef of a struct, union or enum is spelled by its typedef name alone, without package or keyword: 'pair_t'.
- A class: its name without package; if it has parameters, '#(' then every parameter's value, including defaulted ones, in declaration order, separated by ',', then ')': 'fifo_chain#(bit[7:0])', 'fw_rv_if#(bit)'. A type parameter is spelled by this rule. A value parameter: an integral value in decimal (as unsigned for a sized literal: 8'hff is 255; a signed int keeps its sign: -5); a string in double quotes; an enum by its label; a struct value as "'{" then its members' values in declaration order, separated by ',', then '}': "port_c#('{16,2})".
- A class with no parameters: its name: 'leaf'.

component.description: A component. 'type' is its created type.

params.description: The resolved params value (params.md), one key per field of params_t. Empty for a component whose class (or ancestor) declares no params_t of its own. Field values: an integral field as a JSON number, the non-negative integer whose binary representation is the field's bits (int -1 is 4294967295); a value with x or z bits, or wider than 64 bits, as a string "'h" + lowercase hex; a string field as a JSON string; a constructor factory as the canonical type of the realization it creates, or null; a nested struct as an object; an unpacked array or queue as an array.

param_src.description: For each params field whose value some source changed: the last source that changed it, comparing the value before and after each source in resolution order (params.md). A field still at its mk_params default is absent, as is one a source set to the value it already had.

extern.description: Present exactly when the component is an extern: its recorded pin map (extern.md).

params.description: Module parameter name -> its value, from param(). A name set twice keeps the later value. 'type' is the value's type T in the canonical spelling (#/$defs/type), or 'type' for fw_type #(T) (a parameter type). 'value' is spelled as a class's value parameter is (#/$defs/type): an integral value in decimal (as unsigned for an unsigned type, with its sign for a signed one), a string in double quotes, an enum by its label, a packed struct as "'{" members "}"; for a type, the type's canonical spelling.

pins.description: Module pin -> the port it maps to, as a path relative to the extern. One entry per port and bundle member of the extern that is not unused (pin(), a prefix rule, or the default rule). If two ports map to one pin (FW-E-EXT-PIN), the one created first is listed.

ties.description: Module pin -> tied value, from tie().

open.description: Module pins left open, from open(), sorted.

unused.description: Ports with no pin, from unused(): each leaf port as a path relative to the extern, sorted.

signal.description: A local signal. 'type' is its value type T; 'width' is $bits(T).

port.description: A port, on a component or a member of a bundle. 'type' is its value type T; 'width' is $bits(T). 'dir' is the effective direction seen from the port's scope (the component that owns it, or the outermost bundle it is in): the declared direction, flipped by each mirror on the path from the scope, and 'in' if any monitor is on that path; 'inout' stays 'inout' (bundles.md). For a port declared directly on a component it is the declared direction.

bundle.description: A bundle in a role: 'bundle' (initiator), 'mirror' or 'monitor'. 'type' is the bundle type B, without the role: 'fw_rv_if#(bit[7:0])'. Its members are listed as objects of their own.

value.description: A constant: "'h" then lowercase hex digits, without leading zeros ('h0 for zero), x and z for unknown digits: "'h5a".

net.description: One net: the endpoints joined, transitively, by the connections and ties a scope made, classified by their role in that scope (connections.md). Every key is always present.

source.description: The source endpoint, or null when the net is driven by a tie, by inouts, or by nothing. With several sources (FW-E-NET-MULTI) it is the least of them.

tie.description: The tied value, or null. A tie is a source. With several tied endpoints (FW-E-NET-MULTI), the value tied to the least of them.

signals.description: Local signals of the scope on the net, sorted.

diagnostic.description: A diagnostic: its stable id and the path it names (diagnostics.md says which object each id names). The path is '' when there is none (a global override).
